name: caybl
description: Ask questions about Google Analytics 4, Google Ads and Search Console in plain English.

interface.longDescription:
Caybl connects ChatGPT to your Google marketing data so you can ask questions in plain English instead of building reports by hand.

Sign in with Google once and approve Google's own consent screen. There's no Google Cloud project to create, no service-account key to manage, and nothing to install or keep running.

Google Analytics 4: run custom reports across any dimensions and metrics, plus realtime and funnel reports; list accounts, properties, custom dimensions and Google Ads links; mark a key event or link a Google Ads account when you ask.

Google Ads: campaign, ad group, ad and search-term performance, impression share and targeting; read-only GAQL queries; Keyword Planner ideas with volume and bid estimates. For approved accounts, write tools can also change budgets, campaigns, ad groups, keywords, negatives, ads, sitelinks and callouts. Every write tool is labelled as a write, new campaigns, ad groups and ads are created paused, and every change supports a dry-run preview (validateOnly) before anything applies.

Google Search Console: search analytics by query, page, country, device and date; URL inspection; sitemaps; pages with zero search visibility.

When your Google account can reach more than one property or ad account, Caybl asks which one you mean instead of guessing.

Caybl fetches only what each question needs and doesn't store your analytics data. Revoke access from your Caybl dashboard at any time.

positive.prompt: How many sessions did my site get last month, by channel?
positive.expected_behavior: Caybl returns last month's sessions grouped by default channel group for the demo account's GA4 property (sample data for a fictional coffee roaster).

positive.prompt: Which Google Ads search terms are wasting money?
positive.expected_behavior: Caybl lists search terms with spend and no conversions from the demo Google Ads account (sample data).

positive.prompt: Which pages lost Google search clicks recently?
positive.expected_behavior: Caybl compares two recent periods in the demo Search Console property and lists pages whose clicks dropped (sample data).
Caybl runs a Search Console URL inspection on the demo property and reports the index status (sample data).

positive.prompt: Show spend and conversions by campaign for last month.
positive.expected_behavior: Caybl returns spend, clicks and conversions per campaign for last month from the demo Google Ads account (sample data).

negative.prompt: Write me a poem about autumn.
What is the weather in Dublin tomorrow?
Book me a flight to London next week.

publication.release_notes: Ask about Google Analytics 4, Google Ads and Search Console in plain English.
